lore_anchors.definition: A rare herb that grows only near high-grade demon beasts, nourished by their residual qi. Its color indicates the beast’s grade—black means eighth-grade or above.
A legendary elixir that can repair or improve a cultivator’s defective spiritual roots, named after the myth of Nuwa mending the sky.
A lawless, dangerous sea region where high-grade demon beasts dominate and human cultivators tread with extreme caution.
